_note: 19th-century smoothbore cannon external ballistics task parameter specification
description: A 150-200 year old smoothbore cannon firing an 11 cm diameter, 5 kg spherical iron cannonball with muzzle velocity up to 450 m/s across target ranges 1000 m to 1500 m with variable elevation and wind. Find firing angle and muzzle velocity for baseline 1200 m case, and provide a rapid field calculation method for an artillery officer without computers.
source_citation: Standard 19th-century classical ballistics (Didion, Mayevski, Siacci, Bashforth)
primary_target_quantity: Firing angle theta and muzzle velocity v0 for 1200 m nominal range; nomogram and perturbation coefficients for 1000-1500 m ranges with elevation differences and wind

safety_or_acceptance_constraints.rationale: Historical physical parameters defined by problem prompt

air_density_500m.source: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 at altitude 500 m MSL

speed_of_sound_500m.source: U.S. Standard Atmosphere 1976 at altitude 500 m MSL (T = 284.9 K)

subsonic_CD.source: Classical smooth sphere aerodynamic drag coefficient (Re ~ 10^5 - 10^6)

supersonic_CD_peak.source: Mayevski-Didion smooth sphere shockwave drag peak at M ~ 1.2 - 1.4
